summary: Tvardi Therapeutics filed an 8-K on July 17, 2026, disclosing an amendment to its existing at-the-market (ATM) offering program under a Capital on Demand Sales Agreement with JonesTrading. The prospectus supplement increases the available issuance by up to $9.69 million in common stock, subject to the baby shelf rule based on a non-affiliate market value of $62.2 million. The company had previously sold approximately $11.0 million in stock under the program. No other event, transaction, or corporate action is reported. This is a routine capital-raising update, not a special situation.
